entities.summary: The West University of Timișoara is a public higher education institution located in Timișoara. Classified by the Ministry of National Education as a university of education and scientific research, UVT is one of the nine members of the Universitaria Consortium. Also, the West University is a component institution of the National Research–Development–Innovation System in its capacity as an accredited higher education institution.
